The '''Guided Encyclopedia''' is the article and guide standard for the Elite Dangerous Field Manual. EDFM articles should usually answer both of these reader questions on one canonical page:

* '''Reference:''' What is this, how does it work, and why should a Commander care?
* '''Guidance:''' What should I actually do, in what order, and what mistakes should I avoid?

This standard borrows the structural idea of encyclopedia article plus requirements plus walkthrough, but it is not a visual clone of another wiki. Components should feel native to EDFM's dark, compact, field-manual style.

== Philosophy ==
A good EDFM article is a guided encyclopedia entry. It begins with concise reference context, then gives practical preparation and a clear procedure when the subject is actionable. The walkthrough should live on the canonical article unless the guide is a larger journey through several subjects.

Do not assume veteran knowledge. Explain enough for a new Commander to proceed, then link terminology and deeper mechanics to their own EDFM articles rather than re-teaching every system in every guide.

== Article vs guide pages ==
Default behavior: put the walkthrough on the canonical subject article.

Examples that should normally contain their own guidance:

* [[Laser Mining]]
* [[Exobiology]]
* [[Material Trading]]
* [[Fuel Scooping]]
* [[Interdiction]]
* [[Engineering]]
* individual Engineers
* Powerplay mechanics
* Colonisation mechanics

Separate guide pages are for larger objectives that span several independent subjects. Examples:

* [[New Commander Roadmap]]
* [[Guide:Unlocking All Engineers]]
* [[Guide:Preparing for Anti-Xeno Combat]]
* [[Guide:Building Your First Exploration Ship]]
* [[Guide:Starting a Colonisation Project]]

Do not automatically create <code>/Guide</code>, <code>/Quick guide</code>, or <code>Guide:</code> pages for a single subject.

== Normal article anatomy ==
Use only the sections that fit the subject.

# '''Lead''' — what the subject is, what it is used for, why it matters, and essential context.
# '''At a glance''' — a flexible quick-reference panel with relevant fields only.
# '''Before you start''' — required, recommended, and optional preparation, with reasons.
# '''Walkthrough''' — sequential Commander actions.
# '''Common problems''' — troubleshooting linked to relevant mechanics where possible.
# '''Reference material''' — mechanics, tables, variants, locations, rewards, history, notes, see also, and references.
# '''What next?''' — progressive navigation deeper into EDFM or back to a relevant guide.

== Reusable components ==

=== At a glance ===
Use {{tl|Guide info}}. Keep it flexible; do not create a huge infobox with every possible field.

<pre>
{{Guide info|title=At a glance|
; Activity : Laser mining
; Difficulty : Beginner-friendly once outfitted
; Recommended ship : Small or medium ship with mining hardpoints and cargo racks
; Related mechanics : [[Mining]], [[Prospector Limpet Controller]], [[Refinery]]
}}
</pre>

=== Before you start ===
Use {{tl|Requirements}}. Explain why each item matters.

<pre>
{{Requirements|
; Required : Mining laser — extracts fragments from asteroids.
; Strongly recommended : Prospector Limpet Controller — identifies asteroid composition and increases yield.
; Optional : Detailed Surface Scanner — helps find hotspots before entering the ring.
}}
</pre>

=== Walkthrough steps ===
Use {{tl|Guide step}} for substantial steps.

<pre>
{{Guide step|1|Find a suitable ring|
Open the System Map and look for planetary rings with metallic or icy resources. For platinum mining, prefer metallic rings with a platinum hotspot.
}}
</pre>

Steps should be sequential, scannable, and explicit about what the Commander should do.

=== Callouts ===
Use callouts sparingly. Do not turn every paragraph into a colored box.

<pre>
{{Field note|Main-sequence stars of spectral classes O, B, A, F, G, K and M can be fuel-scooped.}}
{{Tip|Plot shorter early routes until you understand fuel usage.}}
{{Important|The roadmap is guidance, not a mandatory progression path.}}
{{Warning|Do not fly a ship you cannot afford to rebuy.}}
</pre>

=== Contextual media ===
Use {{tl|Context media}} when an image belongs beside a specific instruction, not in a bottom gallery.

<pre>
{{Context media|image=Example galaxy map route.png|caption=The Galaxy Map with a short route plotted.|alt=Galaxy Map route plotting screen|
Open the Galaxy Map, select a nearby inhabited system, and choose '''Plot Route'''. Return to the cockpit after the route appears in the navigation panel.
}}
</pre>

Only use screenshots that support the instruction. Avoid decorative images inside procedure steps.

=== What next ===
Use {{tl|What next}} for progressive navigation.

<pre>
{{What next|
* New to mining? Continue with [[Laser Mining]].
* Need module details? Read [[Prospector Limpet Controller]].
* Ready for engineering? Start with [[Engineering]].
}}
</pre>

== Writing style ==
* Write for a Commander who may be performing the activity for the first time.
* Use direct verbs: open, select, plot, launch, dock, scan, sell, refuel.
* Keep paragraphs short inside walkthrough sections.
* Link first-use terminology to deeper articles.
* Avoid unexplained veteran shorthand.
* Keep verified facts distinct from editorial guidance.
* If information is uncertain or not yet reviewed, use the article status system and concise inline notes rather than hiding uncertainty.

== Common problems sections ==
Guides should include troubleshooting when common failure modes exist.

Examples:

* My collector limpets immediately expire.
* The station will not let me dock.
* My Frame Shift Drive says route unavailable.
* My refinery is full.
* The mission target is not appearing.

Explain the likely cause, the immediate fix, and link the relevant deeper mechanic.

== Navigation expectations ==
Guides should lead readers deeper into EDFM. Reference pages should also point back to practical guidance.

Example progression:

[[New Commander Roadmap]] → [[Mining]] → [[Laser Mining]] → [[Prospector Limpet Controller]] → [[Platinum]] → [[Finding Platinum Hotspots]]

A Commander who lands on a reference page from Google should be able to find the practical guide that uses that subject in context.

== Implementation notes for editors ==
* Prefer the templates above rather than raw HTML.
* Use only relevant fields in {{tl|Guide info}} and {{tl|Requirements}}.
* Do not create deep template nesting for ordinary article content.
* Keep screenshots close to the step they explain.
* Preserve EDFM's visual identity: dark panels, compact labels, orange action accents, cyan reference accents.
